Agapito E. Santangelo

Applied economist · PhD — University of Molise

I am an applied economist: I evaluate public policies with causal inference, unconventional digital data and machine learning.

Much of my recent work studies how digitalisation transforms the public sector — from EU cohesion funds to municipal digital services — using difference-in-differences designs, panel data and archived web traces. I also work on health, institutions and territorial dynamics.

I also work as a Data Analysis Strategist at Instant Analytics, applying text mining and machine learning to real-time monitoring of socioeconomic phenomena: a useful complement to my academic research, because it shows how these methods behave in practice.

I hold a PhD in Economics from the University of Molise with the Doctor Europaeus distinction, including a visiting period at the Universitat Politècnica de València. I serve as a reviewer for PLOS ONE.
